label.purpose: Drawing labels, form labels, title-block keys, state tags.

mono.purpose: Client IDs, secret labels, actor IDs, timestamps, validity windows.

motion.name: cut
motion.purpose: The break-line drawn across a revoked credential.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Button, input, and hover state changes.

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: The live indicator on the signal band.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The sheet's one decisive action — submit, register, sign in. Full width in forms.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; padding: 11px 16px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper-raised); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s ease-out, border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--signal); border-color: var(--signal); color: #fff6f3; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Row-level action, such as revoking one Client Secret.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper-raised); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A labeled field on raised paper with a condensed uppercase label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.11em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2); margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-2); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--paper-3); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--signal); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--ink); }

components.name: Register Item
components.description: The sheet index. The active sheet inverts its mono index cell — never a colored side stripe.
components.css: .ds-reg-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px 1fr; align-items: baseline; padding: 7px 18px; color: var(--ink-2); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.92rem; } .ds-reg-index { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.66rem; color: var(--ink-3); justify-self: start; padding: 1px 5px; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-reg-active { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; } .ds-reg-active .ds-reg-index { color: var(--paper-3); background: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); }

components.name: Credential Row (the cut)
components.description: A concurrent Client Secret with its validity window; a revoked row draws the break-line.
components.css: .ds-cred { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px 1fr auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-2); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--paper-3); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 0.84rem; } .ds-cred-ink { width: 18px; height: 0; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink); } .ds-cred-label { color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-cred-validity { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.64rem; color: var(--ink-3); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-cred-state { font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 0.62rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--signal); } .ds-cred-revoked::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 9px; right: 9px; top: 50%; border-top: 1.5px solid var(--signal); transform-origin: left center; animation: ds-cut 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; pointer-events: none; } @keyframes ds-cut { from { transform: scaleX(0); } to { transform: scaleX(1); } }

components.name: Application Node
components.description: An Application tapped off the trust-boundary bus, carrying its public op number.
components.css: .ds-node { position: relative; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--paper-3); padding: 9px 10px 10px; text-align: left; font-family: var(--font-ui); color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; } .ds-node::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 18px; top: -13px; height: 13px; border-left: 1.5px solid var(--ink); } .ds-node:hover { background: var(--paper-2); } .ds-node-type { display: block; font-family: var(--font-label); font-size: 0.6rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-node-name { display: block; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; margin: 1px 0 5px; } .ds-node-id { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.62rem; color: var(--ink-2); }

narrative.overview: IdentiK's interface is a live engineering sheet: the Organization's security architecture drawn to scale. A title block heads the page, an indexed register runs down the left edge, and the field holds a single-line diagram of the trust boundary. The world is paper, not glass: a cool drawing-paper ground, graphite ink, and one full-bleed dark instrument band carrying a live authentication trace. A single revision-red signal does the work of authority; every audit event lands in a numbered revision log and every revocation is a cut.
keyCharacteristics: A drawing sheet — title block, indexed register, bounded field, revision log — not a sidebar-plus-cards admin shell.
Drawing paper ground with graphite ink; exactly one saturated signal (revision red).
Technical lettering: a squared grotesque for UI, a condensed face for drawing labels, a wide mono reserved for codes, serials, and measurements.
Flat by construction: 1.5px black borders and hairline rules, no shadows, near-square corners.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Exactly one saturated hue exists. Anything that needs a second accent is using state that should be a label, a line style, or weight instead.

rules.name: The Honest Ground Rule
rules.body: The ground is cool paper, never warm cream and never blue-black slate. Depth comes from hairlines and the one dark band.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only where the value is a code, a serial, a duration, or a timestamp — never for prose, headings, or labels.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Declare elevation once: a border or a rule, never both around the same element. Rows are flat at rest and do not lift on hover.

dos: Do frame every dashboard surface as a sheet with a title block and a live revision count.
Do reserve revision red for authority and irreversible action.
Do set every Client ID, secret label, timestamp, and duration in mono with tabular numerals.
Do keep the schematic grid only on measurement surfaces.
Do give every state a text or line-style equivalent so color is never the sole signal.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent, a gradient, glass, or a blur.
Don't add drop shadows, halos, or hover lift.
Don't round corners past 2px or use pills.
Don't use a colored side stripe to mark selection; invert the index cell instead.
Don't set prose in monospace, or a display face in labels and data.
